entities.summary: General George Keppel, 3rd Earl of Albemarle,, styled Viscount Bury until 1754, was a British Army officer and politician who served in the War of the Austrian Succession, Jacobite rising of 1745 and Seven Years' War. He is best known for his victory over the Spanish during the siege of Havana in 1762.
